t: A solar powered outdoor Meshtastic relay that mounts on a pole or roof.
steps: Buy the P1 or P1-Pro from Seeed Studio. The P1-Pro includes batteries and GPS.
Add four button-top 18650 batteries to the base P1.
Attach the antenna with its RP-SMA cable before you power on.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone and pair it over Bluetooth.
Set your region and pick a router or client role.
Test messages from a second node on the ground.
Mount the node high on your own wall or pole with the included brackets.
Update the firmware with the Meshtastic web flasher after a flash erase.
meta: Open Code. From $65.61. A few stores.
